artifacts.description: Main compliance page HTML. Contains Section I (EHI Export) describing CSV and HTML formats for single and multi-patient export, and Section II (API documentation) linking to the developer portal.
Full-page screenshot of the compliance page showing the complete rendered content.

Pre-rendered Swagger UI page containing the MediEHR Patient Access API documentation (v2.1). Documents 4 endpoints: login test, patient search, token rotation, and C-CDA 2.1 patient data export. The export endpoint (mediehrgetpatientdata.php) supports 19 selectable C-CDA sections. Also includes API Terms of Use and error code table.
Screenshot of the developer portal API documentation page (Oracle APEX app) showing the Swagger UI embedded in an iframe.

FHIR Bundle (collection) containing the service base URL endpoint and organization resources. Points to InteropEngine sandbox FHIR R4 server. This is the (g)(10) FHIR API, separate from the (b)(10) EHI export.

Public FHIR API page. Links to InteropEngine sandbox, registration, and FHIR endpoints. Production endpoints listed as 'Coming Soon'. This documents the (g)(10) standardized API, not the (b)(10) EHI export.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses API_Document.html and extracts structured endpoint, parameter, and error code data into JSON.
Structured JSON extraction of the MediEHR Patient Access API: 4 endpoints with all parameters, response formats, 19 C-CDA section toggles, and 8 error codes.
Documentation for enrichment scripts: run commands, input/output boundaries, and known limitations.
